summary: Strong directional wicks are powerful generic exhaustion information on both eligible mappings, but only Daily/H1 shows a statistically defensible incremental pivot-core interaction beyond that generic wick effect. Daily/H1 interaction is +0.92 pp with 95% CI [+0.49,+1.36], positive in 8/10 pairs and all leave-one-pair-out tests positive. Weekly/H4 is +0.77 pp but fails because its CI crosses zero and p=0.0744.

primary_findings.uncertainty: 95% CI [+0.49,+1.36], development +1.13 pp, validation +0.39 pp, 8/10 pairs

primary_findings.metric: Daily/H1 generic outer strong-minus-weak wick effect
primary_findings.uncertainty: descriptive companion effect; demonstrates wick exhaustion is largely generic

robustness: Daily core terminal probability rises monotonically across frozen wick bins: 7.20%, 9.53%, 11.88%, 14.13%, 19.43%.
Daily pooled interaction remains positive after removing any one pair.
Daily effect survives development/validation sign, bootstrap interval, multiplicity and breadth gates.
Weekly has a coherent wick gradient and 9/10 positive pair interactions but correctly remains failed because the uncertainty gate is not met.
Separate arithmetic recalculation reproduced both eligible difference-in-differences interactions exactly.
limitations: The dominant wick signal is generic: strong wicks increase terminal probability substantially even away from pivots; the daily pivot premium is incremental and modest.
The endpoint remains retrospectively confirmed even though wick geometry is observable at candle close.
This is a conditional internal mechanism result because parent eligibility was selected on the same exposed 2015-2021 sample.
